events.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m here—what’s left to do for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Gus: Glad you made it—there’s still a stack of small fixes to tackle, and I can lend you my tools if you need them.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus—your tools would help a lot. Point me to the smallest fixes, and I’ll get started right away.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rey: I can help, Gus — what kind of repair drive are we talking about?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Mostly a quick tool-and-fix drive — folks bring in busted stuff, and I lend whatever gear they need to patch it up.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Rey: That sounds handy. I can bring a few tools and help out if you want.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll sort the donated parts and label what still needs fixing. What should I tackle first?
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Great — start with the smallest, easiest fixes and set those aside for anyone ready to jump in. I’ve got tools on hand if you need anything.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll pull the small easy fixes first and set them aside. If I run into anything tricky, I’ll grab the tools from you.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Mostly the little fixes first—loose screws, wobbly hinges, and anything that just needs a quick patch. I’ve got a toolbox here if you want to grab what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Kira: Can you confirm the timing and the drop-off spot before we move anything?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Gus: Yep — we’re starting at 3 by the community shed, and folks can drop things off right by the side table.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: I’ll swing by later and see what they still need, then I’ll pass it along. If you’ve got work gloves or a hand truck, bring those just in case.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll bring the gloves and hand truck, and I’ll keep an eye out for anything else they need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Perfect, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’ll check in later and let you know if they still need extra hands or any haul-offs.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Hana: I’d still like to check the repair drive details before I commit. If you have them, can you remind me what’s set so I can be sure?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Gus: Of course — it’s a quick tool-and-fix drive where folks bring busted items and I lend out whatever gear they need to patch them up. If you want, I can also go over what’s already set and what still needs volunteers.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Hana: Yes please — could you go over what’s already set and what still needs volunteers? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I commit.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Nell: I’ve only heard that the donations and tools are still coming in, and the list is growing nicely. If you hear of any spare supplies, I’ll pass them along.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Gus: That’s great — I’ll keep an eye out for any spare tools or supplies and send them your way if I find any.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate it. I’ll keep passing along any updates I hear about the drive.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: Saturday morning at the community center still works for me. I’ll sort the tools and help match volunteers to jobs.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Gus: That’s a huge help, Eli — thanks. I’ve got the repair tables and main tool bins set; we still need a couple extra hands for intake and parts runs.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: Glad to help, Gus. I can handle intake and help direct the parts runs—just let me know where you want me first.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus—what time do you want me to start, and should I begin at intake or with the parts runs?
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Gus: Start at intake, and if you can swing it, jump to parts runs after that. Let’s say we kick off around 9 Saturday morning at the community center.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: 9 Saturday morning at the community center works for me. I’ll start at intake and move to parts runs after that.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the tape and screws set aside, and I’m sorting through the spare tools. Just send me the time and address for the repair drive, and I’ll help point folks the right way.
events.speaker: Cleo
